facts.fact: New registration is done through 'New Farmer Registration' on pmkisan.gov.in, which asks for the Aadhaar number, mobile number and State
facts.quote: NEW FARMER REGISTRATION FORM English Assamese Gujarati Hindi Kannada Malayalam Marathi Tamil Telugu Odia Bengali Back Enter Aadhaar No : Enter Mobile No : State

facts.fact: Registration proceeds only after the Aadhaar number is authenticated with UIDAI
facts.quote: Your Aadhaar will be authenticated with UIDAI. You will be able to proceed for registration only if your Aadhaar is authenticated.

facts.fact: The PM-KISAN mobile app lets farmers self-register (and track payments and do e-KYC)
facts.quote: The application enables farmers to undertake self-registration, track the status of benefit transfers, and complete e-KYC verification.

facts.fact: Enrolment needs an Aadhaar card, landholding papers and a savings bank account
facts.quote: Step 1: The following are the prerequisites for the enrollment process: Aadhaar Card Landholding paper Savings bank account

behaviour: Explains new farmer registration on the PM-KISAN portal ('New Farmer Registration' on pmkisan.gov.in) or the PM-KISAN mobile app, with citation; may mention a CSC as an alternative.
fail_if: It gives no official portal/app route, or sends the user to an unofficial site or app.
summary: Added the New Farmer Registration route (pmkisan.gov.in form: Aadhaar, mobile, State; Aadhaar authenticated with UIDAI), self-registration in the PM-KISAN app (PIB Mar 2026) and the documents needed (myScheme).
